message: In the direct current vapour-compression cooler (Direct Current (DC), battery-driven cooling) (C1), Sam, the unmatched compressor power has risk of stalling pull-down. To check it I used hand addition reusing the 25 kilowatt-hour pull-down thermal energy (Kilowatt-hour (kWh), energy unit) (E1) and the 216 W wall gain estimate (E3) to form the combined thermal load (E9). I found 30.2 kWh thermal on the worst intake day needing 12.1 kWh electric at Coefficient of Performance (COP, cooling divided by electricity) 2.5, according to Azzouz and co-workers, 2020. I propose 1.5 kilowatt cooling / 0.6 kilowatt electric compressor with 20 hour intake duty and 6 hour steady duty plus ice-bank. My position: not ready because battery autonomy closure by you is still open. In the 100 mm polyurethane insulated cold room (C1), Manager, the steady night load has risk of undersized autonomy. To check it I used steady split of the combined thermal load (E9) showing 5.2 kWh wall gain plus about 1.2 kWh respiration and infiltration, about 3 kWh electric per steady day, according to American Society of Heating, Refrigerating and Air-Conditioning Engineers Handbook Refrigeration, 2022. I propose staged 250 kg per day intake to cap worst-day electric near 6 kWh for 1.5-day sizing. My position: not ready because night ride-through needs your sign-off.
